A '''battle''' took place on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the hunt for [[Nightsisters|Nightsister]] [[Yansu Grjak]].

==Prelude==
Before the hunt, two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were sent to the ''[[Sedawan]]'' when Grjak [[Battle on the Sedawan|attacked]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were able to attach a homing beacon to her [[Star Courier/Legends|Star Courier]] before she got away. They reported to the council that the tracker reported she was on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] before the signal disappeared. It was decided that two Jedi would go.

==Battle at Hand==
On Rodia, the Republic sent a [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-Wing starfighter]] and a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Republic Gunship]] to attack the city, but unfortunately, the shield was put up and the Y-wing crashed with the two Jedi in it. Luckily, they survived, but their troops were stuck outside the city. The Jedi soon made their way into a sub compartment with many [[battle droid]]s. After destroying a [[Trade Federation submarine]] and escaping the compartment, they proceeded to disable the shield generators while passing through many areas with [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droids]]. They finally made it on to a bridge. A [[Kwazel Maw/Legends|creature]] was present in the water, but was thought to be trapped when the Jedi closed the gate. However, it attacked the two Jedi, and they were forced to kill the creature. After passing the under water corridor they made it to a containment unit, and proceeded to look for clues on Grjak's location.

==Hunt for Yansu Grjak==
Soon after, Grjak appeared with several [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]. She fled and the Jedi quickly killed their opponents. After passing through several more areas, battling Nightsisters on their way, the Jedi found themselves in a train yard. Grjak damaged the train generator and fled, leaving the Jedi to fix it manually. Once powered up, the Jedi gave chase on a train. Grjak used [[The Force/Legends|The Force]] to throw several droids at them. The Jedi evaded the droids and jumped off the trains before they collided. They continued the search, fighting even more Nightsisters and a few [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Finally, they came to a large room where Grjak was speaking with fellow Nightsister [[Sai Sircu]], and [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. Grjak informed them that the Jedi had been eliminated by the Nightsisters. The Jedi were contacted by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], who had finally breached the shield. The explosion revealed the Jedi's presence to the Nightsister, and she attacked. After a fierce battle, the two Jedi finally killed Grjak.
